instrument.evidence: For LC–MS/MS analysis, resuspended peptides were separated by reversed-phase chromatography on a Dionex Ultimate 3000 RSLC nano UPLC system connected in-line with an Orbitrap Q-exactive HF (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
